claims.summary: exact_reference_delimiter_pair (L153-197) and exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199-229) detect delimited markers and drive preservation.
claims.disposition: Verified L153-229: pair maps quote/group delimiter pairs (incl 「」) to Quoted/GroupedExactKnownToken; syntax resolves context from the innermost non-whitespace pair. Preservation covered by preserves_non_ascii_matching_quote_pairs (L2342) and exact_reference_delimiter_syntax_reports_double_square_bracket_depth_two (L2963).

claims.summary: scan_known_model_control_markers (L114-144) is a linear scan reconstructing a remainder plus KnownModelControlMarkerMatch objects.
claims.disposition: Verified L114-144: linear byte scan; at each known marker it records a KnownModelControlMarkerMatch and, when reference_syntax is present, re-pushes the token into remainder, else advances one UTF-8 char. Byte-exactness/adjacency covered by scanner_advances_byte_exactly_across_multibyte_text (L2099) and scanner_removes_adjacent_mixed_markers_without_rewriting_remainder (L1795).

claims.summary: Snag 1: MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH (L151) might not be enforced for nested delimiters, risking incorrect preservation.
claims.disposition: Source contradicts the feared gap: exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199-229) DOES enforce depth — before/after collect .take(MAX=4) non-ws chars, context is taken from the innermost pair, and delimiter_depth counts concentric matching pairs via take_while. Beyond-cap nesting cannot cause incorrect preservation (context still resolves from the innermost pair). Covered by bounds_homogeneous_square_bracket_stack_beyond_max_depth (L2266, cites sibling 1787026288) + reports_exact_four/three_level_delimiter_depth (L2194/L2208). Her cap-correctness concern is preserved.

claims.summary: Snag 2: longest_exact_known_model_control_marker_at (L97-112) greedy longest-match might obscure the intended sequence for shared-prefix markers.
claims.disposition: Verified L97-112: max_by_key(token.len()) over KNOWN markers the tail starts_with (maximal munch). Enumerated all 20 KNOWN_MODEL_CONTROL_MARKERS (fallback_contracts.rs L159): NO marker is a strict prefix of another, so the shared-prefix obscuring hypothesized cannot occur with the current set. Longest-match exercised by preserves_longest_overlapping_token_when_named_as_content (L2493). Forward-looking concern (future shared-prefix additions) preserved.
